## Motivation

This PR introduces layer-pipelined KV transfer for PD disaggregation on the Mooncake backend.

In the existing PD disaggregation path, the prefill server finishes the full forward pass before transferring KV cache to decode. For long-prefill workloads, KV transfer can become a visible part of end-to-end latency. Layer-pipelined KV transfer streams KV cache by layer groups as soon as those layers are produced, allowing Mooncake transfer to overlap with the remaining prefill compute.

This is intended to improve long-context PD serving latency while keeping the existing transfer path as the default behavior.

## Modifications

- Add layer-pipelined KV transfer support for Mooncake PD disaggregation.
  - Add `--enable-disagg-layer-pipeline`.
  - Add `--disagg-layer-group-size`.
  - Add `--disagg-layer-pipeline-min-prefill-len`.
  - Add request-level fallback to the legacy transfer path for short requests.

- Add CP transfer shard mode support for the NSA-CP all-rank transfer path.
  - Add `--disaggregation-cp-transfer-shard-mode`.
  - This flag is only valid when NSA CP is used together with `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_ALL_CP_RANKS_TRANSFER=1`.
  - Under that condition, it must be set to `layer`; `page` should not be used for this path.
  - Keep the default non-NSA / non-all-CP transfer behavior unchanged.
  - Keep the existing env override `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_CP_TRANSFER_SHARD_MODE` as a deprecated compatibility path.

- Add Mooncake sender/receiver support for layer-group KV chunks.
  - Transfer main KV by layer groups.
  - Send aux data through a trailing finalizer chunk.
  - Handle draft KV separately after draft forward.
  - Support NSA state transfer with layer-pipelined chunks.
  - Add watermark/progress tracking for multi-chunk LP transfer.

- Add compatibility and safety handling.
  - LP only engages when both prefill and decode support compatible LP settings.
  - Add handshake warnings for LP setting mismatches, including group size and KV dtype mismatch.
  - Preserve the legacy single/fan-out transfer path when LP is disabled or not eligible.
  - Keep default CP behavior unchanged unless the NSA-CP all-rank layer-shard path is explicitly selected.

- Add observability.
  - Add LP chunk count metric.
  - Add per-layer-group transfer latency metric.
  - Add actual transfer duration accounting.
  - Add debug-only LP environment variable warnings.

- Add documentation.
  - Add `docs/advanced_features/disagg_layer_pipeline.md`.
  - Add the new page to `docs/index.rst`.

- Add unit tests for:
  - LP min-prefill-length fallback.
  - Layer-group chunking and watermark behavior.
  - Draft KV transfer behavior.
  - NSA state transfer behavior.
  - Default CP transfer behavior and NSA-CP all-rank layer-shard behavior.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces layer-pipelined KV transfer for Prefill-Decode (PD) disaggregation, allowing KV cache RDMA transfer to overlap with the prefill server's remaining-layer compute. It includes new benchmarks, documentation, server argument handling, scheduler integration, metrics reporting, and e2e tests. The review feedback highlights several critical issues: an invalid `logger.warning_once` call that will cause a runtime error, a potential `TypeError` when calling `len()` on 0-dimensional PyTorch tensors, inaccurate throughput calculations in the benchmark script that include failed requests, potential URL formatting bugs due to trailing slashes, and a missing initialization check in the metrics reporter that could crash the server.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Standard Python `logging.Logger` does not have a `warning_once` method. Calling `logger.warning_once` will raise an `AttributeError` at runtime if a PD layer pipeline setting mismatch occurs between prefill and decode servers. Use `logger.warning` instead to ensure the warning is logged safely without crashing the server.

```suggestion
            logger.warning(
                "PD layer pipeline setting mismatch between prefill and decode "
                f"(prefill={info.layer_pipeline_enabled}, decode={self.layer_pipeline_enabled}); "
                "falling back to non-layer-pipeline transfer for this connection."
            )
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The throughput calculation `throughput_req_per_sec` is currently based on `num_requests` (the target number of requests), which includes any requests that failed during the benchmark. To ensure accurate throughput reporting, it should be calculated using only the successfully completed requests (`len(measured)`).

```suggestion
        "throughput_req_per_sec": (
            (len(measured) / wall_elapsed) if wall_elapsed > 0 else None
        ),
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

If `lb_url` has a trailing slash, concatenating it directly with `"/generate"` will result in a URL with double slashes (e.g., `...//generate`), which can cause 404 errors depending on the router/reverse proxy configuration. Strip any trailing slashes from `lb_url` before appending the path.

```suggestion
    r = requests.post(lb_url.rstrip("/") + "/generate", json=payload, timeout=timeout)
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

If `args.lb_url` has a trailing slash, concatenating it directly with `"/health"` will result in a URL with double slashes (e.g., `...//health`), which can cause 404 errors depending on the router/reverse proxy configuration. Strip any trailing slashes from `args.lb_url` before appending the path.

```suggestion
        h = requests.get(args.lb_url.rstrip("/") + "/health", timeout=10)
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Accessing `self.scheduler.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue.kv_manager` directly without checking if `disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue` is initialized can lead to an `AttributeError` and crash the metrics reporting thread if disaggregation is not fully set up or in certain edge cases. Use defensive programming to safely retrieve the queue and manager.

```suggestion
                bootstrap_queue = getattr(self.scheduler, "disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue", None)
                kv_mgr = bootstrap_queue.kv_manager if bootstrap_queue is not None else None
                # Gate explicitly on layer_pipeline_enabled (not on
                # method presence) so a backend that defines the method
                # but doesn't run LP — e.g. NIXL/Mori with future hook
                # support compiled in but disabled — does not export
                # zero-valued LP metrics that pollute Prometheus.
                if kv_mgr is not None and getattr(kv_mgr, "layer_pipeline_enabled", False):
                    pop_lp_metrics = kv_mgr.pop_layer_pipeline_metrics
                    (
                        self.stats.kv_transfer_layer_group_chunks_delta,
                        self.stats.kv_transfer_layer_group_ms_samples,
                    ) = pop_lp_metrics()
```

+# Layer-Pipelined KV Transfer for PD Disaggregation
+
+This page documents `--enable-disagg-layer-pipeline`, an opt-in
+optimization for the [Prefill–Decode disaggregation](./pd_disaggregation.md)
+path that overlaps KV cache RDMA transfer with the prefill server's
+remaining-layer compute. It is currently supported on the **Mooncake**
+transfer backend.
+
+## What it does
+
+Without layer pipelining the prefill server runs its entire forward
+pass, then ships the full KV cache for the request to the decode
+server in one or more chunks. Compute and RDMA run **strictly
+sequentially**, so total end-to-end latency is `compute_time +
+transfer_time`.
+
+With layer pipelining a forward hook on `RadixAttention` fires after
+every layer's KV bytes are committed to the pool. The hook batches
+adjacent layers into **layer groups** (configurable via
+`--disagg-layer-group-size`, default 4) and enqueues one RDMA transfer
+per group. While the prefill server is still computing the later
+layers, Mooncake is already shipping the earlier groups' KV. End-to-end
+latency becomes approximately `max(compute_time, transfer_time)` plus
+the cost of the trailing aux/state finalizer.
+
+## When to enable
+
+LP gives the most benefit when:
+
+- **Prompts are long** (≥ a few thousand tokens). Short prompts'
+  compute finishes before the first layer group is even ready to ship,
+  leaving no room to overlap. The default
+  `--disagg-layer-pipeline-min-prefill-len=2048` skips LP for shorter
+  requests automatically.
+- **RDMA bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck** between prefill
+  and decode. Long-context or high-batch prefill stresses the network;
+  LP folds that transfer time under compute.
+- The transfer backend is **Mooncake**. Enabling LP with a non-Mooncake
+  backend is rejected at startup; leave LP disabled for NIXL / Mori.
+
+LP gives little or no benefit when:
+
+- Prompts are short or batches are small (compute dominates).
+- Network is faster than compute (transfer was never the bottleneck).
+- The deployment uses speculative decoding with a draft model AND the
+  draft KV is large relative to main — see "Draft KV" below.
+
+## Flags
+
+| Flag | Default | Notes |
+|---|---|---|
+| `--enable-disagg-layer-pipeline` | off | Master toggle. Both prefill and decode must enable it for LP to engage. |
+| `--disagg-layer-group-size` | 4 | Layers per RDMA group. Must match between prefill and decode (mismatch logs a warning at handshake and silently falls back to legacy). |
+| `--disagg-layer-pipeline-min-prefill-len` | 2048 | Request total length (tokens) below which LP is skipped per-request. |
+| `--disaggregation-cp-transfer-shard-mode` | `page` | `layer` mode partitions LAYER GROUPS across CP ranks (vs the default page-shard); only meaningful with NSA prefill CP where every CP rank holds identical KV. |
+
+The env vars `SGLANG_DISAGG_LAYER_PIPELINE`,
+`SGLANG_DISAGG_LAYER_GROUP_SIZE`, and
+`SGLANG_DISAGG_LAYER_PIPELINE_MIN_PREFILL_LEN` also work; they override
+the CLI flags when set. `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_CP_TRANSFER_SHARD_MODE`
+exists for back-compat but is deprecated in favor of the CLI flag.
+
+## Expected speedup
+
+A rough rule of thumb for a long-prompt 1P2D deployment on H200 +
+RDMA: with `--disagg-layer-group-size=4` LP folds 30–50% of the
+transfer wall-clock under compute on the prefill side, depending on
+how close compute and transfer times are. The maximum theoretical
+saving is `min(compute_time, transfer_time)` per request; LP can't
+beat the bound. If your profiling shows transfer time ≪ compute time
+(or vice versa), the benefit will be small.
+
+## Metrics
+
+Two Prometheus metrics are exported only when LP is enabled:
+
+- `sglang:kv_transfer_layer_group_chunks_total` (Counter) — number
+  of LP chunks shipped per request. Stays 0 when LP is off.
+- `sglang:kv_transfer_layer_group_ms` (Histogram) — per-group
+  enqueue→RDMA-completion wall-clock. Histogram buckets cover up to
+  5000 ms for long-context groups.
+
+When LP is disabled the metrics remain registered but not exported.
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+### "LP is enabled on both sides but I see no speedup"
+
+Check the prefill server startup log for a handshake warning:
+
+```
+WARNING ... Layer-pipeline group-size mismatch with decode session ...
+```
+
+A mismatch in `--disagg-layer-group-size` between prefill and decode,
+or a `kv_cache_dtype` mismatch, silently disables LP and falls back to
+the legacy fan-out. Both sides must agree on group size for LP to
+engage.
+
+### "I set --disaggregation-cp-transfer-shard-mode=layer but transfer still page-shards"
+
+`layer` mode only engages when **all four** conditions hold:
+
+1. `--enable-disagg-layer-pipeline` is on.
+2. All CP ranks participate in transfer (e.g. NSA prefill CP).
+3. `attn_cp_size > 1`.
+4. The shard mode resolves to `layer`.
+
+If any of these fails, the helper degrades to page-shard silently
+(this is the safe default — non-CP0 ranks would otherwise skip pages
+that no one covers).
+
+### "Where can I see if LP fired for a request?"
+
+Look at `_hook_enqueued_chunks` on the sender's request trace, or
+inspect the `sglang:kv_transfer_layer_group_chunks_total` counter
+delta. Per-request LP attribution lives in the request's time_stats
+under `transfer_latency_ms`.
+
+## Limitations
+
+- **Mooncake only.** The LP flag requires Mooncake; NIXL / Mori should
+  run with LP disabled and use the regular transfer path.
+- **No HiSparse support.** Startup fails if
+  `--enable-disagg-layer-pipeline` and `--enable-hisparse` are both set.
+- **No draft KV pipelining** — the draft pool's KV is shipped in a
+  single trailing chunk by `send_draft_kv` after the main forward
+  completes. For models with proportionally large draft KV (e.g.
+  EAGLE-3) this is a small fixed overhead per request.
+- **Group size must match** between prefill and decode — see
+  Troubleshooting.
+- **Short requests bypass LP** below
+  `--disagg-layer-pipeline-min-prefill-len`.
+
+## See also
+
+- [PD Disaggregation overview](./pd_disaggregation.md) — base mechanism.
+- [Forward hooks](./forward_hooks.md) — the underlying hook framework.

Standard Python `logging.Logger` does not have a `warning_once` method. Calling `logger.warning_once` will raise an `AttributeError` at runtime if a PD layer pipeline setting mismatch occurs between prefill and decode servers. Use `logger.warning` instead to ensure the warning is logged safely without crashing the server.

```suggestion
            logger.warning(
                "PD layer pipeline setting mismatch between prefill and decode "
                f"(prefill={info.layer_pipeline_enabled}, decode={self.layer_pipeline_enabled}); "
                "falling back to non-layer-pipeline transfer for this connection."
            )
```

The throughput calculation `throughput_req_per_sec` is currently based on `num_requests` (the target number of requests), which includes any requests that failed during the benchmark. To ensure accurate throughput reporting, it should be calculated using only the successfully completed requests (`len(measured)`).

```suggestion
        "throughput_req_per_sec": (
            (len(measured) / wall_elapsed) if wall_elapsed > 0 else None
        ),
```

If `lb_url` has a trailing slash, concatenating it directly with `"/generate"` will result in a URL with double slashes (e.g., `...//generate`), which can cause 404 errors depending on the router/reverse proxy configuration. Strip any trailing slashes from `lb_url` before appending the path.

```suggestion
    r = requests.post(lb_url.rstrip("/") + "/generate", json=payload, timeout=timeout)
```

Accessing `self.scheduler.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue.kv_manager` directly without checking if `disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue` is initialized can lead to an `AttributeError` and crash the metrics reporting thread if disaggregation is not fully set up or in certain edge cases. Use defensive programming to safely retrieve the queue and manager.

```suggestion
                bootstrap_queue = getattr(self.scheduler, "disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue", None)
                kv_mgr = bootstrap_queue.kv_manager if bootstrap_queue is not None else None
                # Gate explicitly on layer_pipeline_enabled (not on
                # method presence) so a backend that defines the method
                # but doesn't run LP — e.g. NIXL/Mori with future hook
                # support compiled in but disabled — does not export
                # zero-valued LP metrics that pollute Prometheus.
                if kv_mgr is not None and getattr(kv_mgr, "layer_pipeline_enabled", False):
                    pop_lp_metrics = kv_mgr.pop_layer_pipeline_metrics
                    (
                        self.stats.kv_transfer_layer_group_chunks_delta,
                        self.stats.kv_transfer_layer_group_ms_samples,
                    ) = pop_lp_metrics()
```
